sourceDiscipline.cms1115Demo: CMS publishes no structured API for 1115 demonstration approval periods; the demonstration page itself (its 'Waiver Dates' and 'Supporting Documents' blocks) is the cited source of record. A dedicated parser atom (ParseCmsDemonstrationPage.ts) throws if either landmark is missing rather than silently returning wrong or empty dates — verified against both real fetched pages before being wired into the molecule.
sourceDiscipline.grantsGov: Live-verified the search2 API's real filter field is 'cfda', not 'aln' (aln is silently ignored and returns the unfiltered catalog). Every NOFO event is scope='national' and attached to both states, never presented as state-eligibility-verified.
sourceDiscipline.everyEventCited: Structural reconciliation check (OFR-HORIZON-EVERY-EVENT-CITED) fails the gate if any event is missing a source_document_uri or retrieved_at — the plan's stated exit gate for this package.
sourceDiscipline.noOutcomePrediction: Structural reconciliation check (OFR-HORIZON-NO-RENEWAL-OUTCOME-PREDICTED) scans every status string for renewal-outcome-prediction language and fails the gate if any is found.
sourceDiscipline.documentedGap: Individual state 1915(b)/(c) waiver authorities (named in the plan under '1915 authorities') have no comparable CMS structured page — recorded as GAP-1915-KY/GAP-1915-FL in the completion report rather than hand-transcribed without a reconciliation path.
